title: PBA: Rain or Shine rallies for Game 1 win vs. Converge
summary: The Rain or Shine Elasto Painters overhauled a double-digit deficit to stun Converge, 124-120, in Game 1 of their quarterfinal series in the 2026 PBA Governors' Cup, Tuesday at the Araneta Coliseum.
